description: Plans and pricing for Septena, the task app (ADR 0010, ADR 0023). One source for the pricing page, the in-app Septena Plus page and the upsell moments. `limits` holds the machine values per plan; the server plan table reads the same values. `cells` is the copy for each level, and the generator checks that every numeric limit appears in its cell.
name: Septena Plus
headline: Free on one device. Plus on all of them.
subhead: Every task feature is free on the device you use. Plus syncs your list to all your devices and keeps its full history and files. It also lets your agents work without a daily cap.

checkout.notice: Subscriptions open at App Store launch.

trial.title: Every new account starts with 14 days of Plus
trial.detail: You do not need a card. After 14 days the account becomes a free account, and your tasks stay where they are.

prices.label: €60 a year
prices.detail: €5 a month. You save €24 against paying monthly.

priceFootnote: Prices include VAT where it applies. Outside the euro area, the App Store charges its matching local price.

cards.title: Free
cards.detail: The full task app on one iPhone, iPad or Mac. You do not need an account.
points: Today with its Inbox, Upcoming, Anytime, Faded and Logbook
Areas, projects, sections, notes and attachments
Task conversations with the on-device model
Import from Things and Apple Reminders
cards.footnote: Sign in for a free account. The server then keeps a backup of that device, and you can try agents on real tasks.

cards.title: Septena Plus
cards.detail: Plus is the same app on every device, and nothing in it is capped.
points: Live sync on every iPhone, iPad and Mac
A year of change history, and a year to restore deleted tasks
Files and images synced, up to 10 GB
Your agents work your tasks without a daily cap

outcomes.title: Your list everywhere
outcomes.detail: The same tasks on your phone, tablet and Mac, updated as you type.

outcomes.title: Nothing lost
outcomes.detail: See who changed what and bring back what you deleted. Your files open on every device.

cells.account: On the device that added them

outcomes.title: Help that keeps working
outcomes.detail: Connect Claude or another agent to your list. It asks before it acts, and you can stop it at any time.

promises.title: The task app stays free
promises.detail: Tasks, lists, projects and areas have no caps on any plan.

promises.title: We never hold your data back
promises.detail: Export works on every plan. A limit hides older items. It never deletes them, and Plus shows them again.

promises.title: Cancel at any time
promises.detail: Your account becomes a free account. Every device keeps its tasks, and the server keeps your synced copy for 12 months.

promises.title: You pay your AI provider, not us
promises.detail: Septena runs the sync server and the connector. When you connect Claude or another agent, its bill stays with that provider.

upsells.title: This device is not syncing
upsells.detail: A free account syncs one device. Plus syncs all of them. You can also move your free account to this device.

upsells.title: Older changes are hidden
upsells.detail: A free account shows 30 days of history. Plus shows a full year.

upsells.title: This file is on another device
upsells.detail: Plus syncs files and images to all your devices.

upsells.title: Agent runs resume on the 1st
upsells.detail: Your free account used its 10 runs this month. The work waits for you. Plus runs it now.

upsells.title: Daily change limit reached
upsells.detail: A free account allows 25 agent changes a day. Plus has no daily cap.

upsells.title: Sharing a project needs Plus
upsells.detail: Anyone can join a shared project for free. Plus lets you create one and invite people.

upsells.title: Your 14 days of Plus have ended
upsells.detail: Your account is now a free account. One device keeps syncing. Your tasks on every device stay where they are.

paywall.trialBilling: If you subscribe during the trial, billing starts on the day you subscribe.
paywall.cancelNote: You can cancel at any time in Settings.
paywall.success: Plus is on. Your other devices start syncing.
paywall.serverRetry: Purchase received. Plus turns on when Septena reaches the server.
paywall.failed: The purchase did not go through. Try again in a moment.
paywall.ownedApple: You have Plus through the App Store.
paywall.ownedWeb: You have Plus through the web. Manage it at septena.app.
paywall.ownedGoogle: You have Plus through Google Play. Manage it in Google Play.
paywall.ownedGrant: Plus is on for this account.
paywall.buyOnIPhone: Subscribe in Septena on your iPhone or iPad. Plus then works on this Mac too.
